rationale: Ground truth is thin: mostly a resolved Q&A about whether attrgetter is redundant outside the dotted case, plus a suggestion to extract a shared 'resolve dotted path' helper mirroring module_collector.py. Neither candidate proposes that exact shared-helper refactor, but Y comes closer by explicitly recommending cache_summary adopt module_collector's warning-on-unresolved-path behavior, while X only cites the pattern as validation evidence. Both candidates go well beyond the ground truth with independently-sourced findings (unfixed getattr in diffusion_model_runner.py/lora manager.py, untested SoulX Singer activation); Y's version of that SoulX finding is materially deeper, tracing an actual sequence-length mismatch bug in DBCache buffers rather than just flagging it as untested, and Y also catches that the new is_cached guard doesn't do what the PR description claims — both show more causal rigor than X's more surface-level sweep/validation style. Y's suggestions are also more concrete (ready-to-drop-in code/logger snippets vs. X's more open-ended 'has this been triaged' questions), giving it an edge on actionability.
